basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I spend my evenings exploring the depths of new video games, particularly fond of Halo Reach. When not gaming, I dive into technical death metal music or explore fascinating underwater creatures like jellyfish. Currently working as a junior IT technician at a local firm, I also dabble in various Kickstarter projects, hoping to find the next big thing. Single, and typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught with a background in information technology from a community college. Extensive knowledge in gaming, particularly FPS games, and a growing interest in marine biology, sparked by a recent fascination with jellyfish. Technical skills are honed through both professional work and personal projects.
